summary: Introduced Confluence Knowledge Sync, allowing users to connect a Confluence workspace and automatically sync page changes to knowledge tables. This keeps AI agents up to date without manual documentation updates.
title: Confluence Knowledge Sync: Keep your AI agents updated with real-time documentation

summary: StackAI introduced Knowledge Base API v2 and new integrations and actions for billing, e-signatures, support, and other services. The update also added quality-of-life improvements and fixed issues with scheduled runs, bulk invites, editors, integrations, and workflow publishing.
title: Mid-July Product Update

summary: This release adds dataset-scoped knowledge-base API keys, keyboard movement for workflow nodes and comments, marketplace creator profiles and a redesigned homepage, and configurable Markdown field-name limits. It also fixes numerous knowledge-base extraction and storage bugs, model-provider upgrade and credential issues, and workflow and Human Input behavior; self-hosted deployments using bundled Weaviate must complete a staged manual upgrade before starting 1.17.1.
title: v1.17.1 - Bug Fixes and Improvements

summary: This release adds Gemini built-in tools, a Teradata MCP server, Loop Agentflow updates, OpenAPI spec loading and tool selection, HTTP URL variables, text-to-speech, and other node and core enhancements. It also includes fixes for Gemini content handling, JSON parsing, URL paths, Google Calendar parameters, and migrations.
title: flowise@3.0.8

summary: Flowise 3.1.4 includes fixes for session ID type validation, workspace authorization and tenant validation, MCP command allowlisting, deny-list checks, and other security and workflow issues, along with package version updates.
title: flowise@3.1.4

summary: n8n 2.43 makes Browser Use available to all users and includes 13 other features.
title: n8n 2.43 Browser Use now available to all users, plus 13 other features

summary: StackAI introduced personal account connections in embedded chats, a fullscreen editor for JSON schemas, and new integrations and actions across web, finance, productivity, and other services. The update also added workflow configuration and evaluation improvements, along with fixes for chat, runs, imports, and integrations.
title: October Product Update

summary: This release adds major Agentflow capabilities, including node execution visualization with HITL support, iteration nodes, scheduling, version detection and upgrades, and improved UI and validation. It also introduces MCP server and Observe features, expands model and integration support, and includes numerous security, stability, and bug fixes.
title: flowise@3.1.3

summary: Concurrency monitoring now shows queued runs above the limit, live slot and waiting-task counts, and running-slot capacity by project. Project admins see other projects’ names and task details anonymized; the charts are available on Analytics for project admins and on Analytics and Plan & Billing for organization admins.
title: Concurrency visibility for project and organization admins

summary: Microsoft Teams triggers now offer an outreach-only mode that routes only direct replies to an Agent’s outbound messages, excluding channel chatter. Configure it in Agent → Triggers → Microsoft Teams.
title: Outreach-only reply mode for Microsoft Teams agents
